answer: Every DISCO in Pakistan, from LESCO and IESCO to K-Electric, bills homes on the same NEPRA domestic tariff, and NEPRA sets one monthly FPA for all of them, so each company's calculator here gives the same bill for the same units. Pick your company below, or use the checks for overbilling, sanctioned load and what an AC adds.

p: [[F2|LESCO]] (Lahore), [[F3|IESCO]] (Islamabad and Rawalpindi), [[F4|MEPCO]] (Multan and south Punjab), [[F5|GEPCO]] (Gujranwala), [[F6|FESCO]] (Faisalabad), [[F7|PESCO]] (Peshawar), [[F8|HESCO]] (Hyderabad), [[F9|SEPCO]] (Sukkur), [[F10|QESCO]] (Quetta), [[F11|TESCO]] (the merged tribal districts) and [[F12|K-Electric]] (Karachi) each have their own page with local notes. The [[F1|electricity bill calculator for Pakistan]] covers all of them in one place with the fullest explanation of the slabs.

sections.h2: Checks on a bill you already have
p: If a bill looks too high, the [[N1|overbilling check]] tests a long reading cycle and the slab it pushed you into, and the [[bill-index|Pakistan Bill Index]] shows the typical bill for your units this month on a {{data.bill_index.sanctioned_kw|int}} kW sanctioned load. The FPA line is explained in the [[F14|FPA guide]] and time-of-use rates in the [[F13|peak hours guide]].
Before adding load, the [[N16|AC bill calculator]] shows what one more AC adds to the whole bill, and the [[N4|sanctioned load calculator]] whether the connection needs a load extension.

faq.q: Is the per unit rate different for LESCO, IESCO and K-Electric?
faq.a: No. All the ex-WAPDA DISCOs and K-Electric bill the uniform NEPRA domestic tariff for the year; the monthly fuel adjustment, FPA on most bills and FCA on K-Electric bills, is one national figure too, so the same units give the same bill; real bills differ only by billing days, arrears and local items.

faq.q: What is the bill for {{pg.F1.out.units|int}} units?
faq.a: About {{pg.F1.out.total_rs|rs}} for an unprotected home on a {{pg.F1.out.sanctioned_kw|int}} kW connection with the {{data.fpa_latest.fpa_for}} FPA pre-filled, of which {{pg.F1.out.energy_rs|rs}} is the energy charge at {{pg.F1.out.rate|rs2}} per unit. The [[F1|electricity bill calculator]] works out any other number of units.

faq.q: Why is my bill higher than the calculator?
faq.a: The estimate uses the pre-filled FPA unless you enter your bill's, and it cannot see arrears, a late payment surcharge or advance income tax on large bills. Copy the FPA from your bill, and if the reading dates cover more than a month, run the [[N1|overbilling check]].

A home whose last {{d.protected_months|int}} bills were all at or under {{d.protected_max_units|int}} units, on a connection below {{d.tou_threshold_kw|int}} kW. Protected homes pay much lower slab rates, and one month over the limit ends the status.
